desc: Upgrade your style while staying safe with easy access to protection with the SABRE Jeweled Pepper Spray with Snap Clip and Snap Clip. The canister contains 25 bursts (5x the competition) for protection against multiple threats from a safe distance. With an industry-exclusive HPLC laboratory, only SABRE guarantees its maximum strength formulation in every canister to help give you peace of mind, certainty, reliability, and safety when you need it most. The twist lock safety prevents an accidental discharge from occurring in your purse or bag. Snap Clip allows for quick and secure attachment onto keys and bags for easy access to your protection when you need it most. Show off your style with the sparkly jeweled monochromatic design. SABRE Pepper Spray is made in USA.
